title: Bob Echols and misspent promotion money
summary: Promoter Bob Robin (Robert Echols) was given a Cadillac and credit card and spent heavily on himself.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope
